1.content:
# 🚨 Event Management Overview
Every Davis event and problem in the timeframe, sliced by **category**, **layer** (from the source entity type), **host group**, **cloud**, **account** and **tag**. Problems are counted when at least one of their events matches the filters. Default timeframe: **last 7 days**.

**First load:** choose **Select all** on *Category*, *Layer*, *HostGroup*, *Cloud* and *Account*. Leave *Tag* empty for everything; pick a *TagKey* to drive the two tag-value tiles.

2.content: ### 🎨 Category colours ■ **Availability** · ■ **Error** · ■ **Slowdown** · ■ **Resource** · ■ **Warning** · ■ **Custom alert** · ■ **Info** · ■ **Other** Same colour for a category on every tile. **Info** (deployments, config changes, process restarts) is grey because it's usually the bulk of the volume, not the signal — deselect it in *Category* to see the alerting picture.

3.title: Davis events
3.query:
fetch dt.davis.events
| lookup [fetch dt.entity.process_group_instance | fields id, pgiHost = belongs_to[dt.entity.host]], sourceField:dt.entity.process_group_instance, lookupField:id, prefix:"pgi."
| fieldsAdd hostId = coalesce(dt.entity.host, pgi.pgiHost)
| lookup [fetch dt.entity.host | fields id, hostGroupName, cloudType], sourceField:hostId, lookupField:id, prefix:"host."
| fieldsAdd hostGroup = coalesce(dt.host_group.id, host.hostGroupName, "(no host group)"),
    cloudRaw = coalesce(if(isNotNull(aws.account.id), "AWS"), if(isNotNull(azure.subscription), "AZURE"), if(isNotNull(gcp.project.id), "GCP"), host.cloudType),
    account = coalesce(aws.account.id, azure.subscription, gcp.project.id, "(none)"),
    srcType = lower(coalesce(dt.smartscape_source.type, dt.source_entity.type, "unknown"))
| fieldsAdd cloud = coalesce(if(cloudRaw == "EC2", "AWS", else: if(cloudRaw == "GOOGLE_CLOUD_PLATFORM", "GCP", else: cloudRaw)), "ON-PREM / OTHER"),
    layer = coalesce(
      if(contains(srcType, "synthetic") or contains(srcType, "monitor") or contains(srcType, "http_check"), "Synthetic"),
      if(startsWith(srcType, "k8s") or startsWith(srcType, "kubernetes") or startsWith(srcType, "cloud_application"), "Kubernetes"),
      if(startsWith(srcType, "cloud:") or startsWith(srcType, "aws") or startsWith(srcType, "azure") or startsWith(srcType, "gcp") or startsWith(srcType, "custom_device"), "Cloud & custom devices"),
      if(contains(srcType, "frontend") or contains(srcType, "application"), "Frontend (RUM)"),
      if(startsWith(srcType, "service"), "Service"),
      if(startsWith(srcType, "process"), "Process"),
      if(startsWith(srcType, "host") or startsWith(srcType, "container"), "Host / container"),
      "Other")
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| filter in(layer, array($Layer))
| filter in(hostGroup, array($HostGroup))
| filter in(cloud, array($Cloud))
| filter in(account, array($Account))
| filter contains(coalesce(arrayToString(entity_tags, delimiter:"|"), ""), $Tag, caseSensitive:false)
| makeTimeseries Events = count(default:0), time:event.start
| fieldsAdd Total = arraySum(Events)
3.description: Events matching the filters, with trend.
